objective: Fit the loop metric: average views per viewer.

notes: counts, rates, sources and the follower split transcribed verbatim from the screenshots and the PDF. The retention, likes-timing and three views-over-time curves were digitized from the screenshot pixels: magenta-stroke centroid per column, y mapped through each chart's own gridlines. x is NOT linear to duration here: both 0:00-0:16 charts plot 17 evenly spaced vertices (measured 66.9 px apart), one per whole second 0-16, so keypoints sit on whole seconds; the views charts plot one vertex per day, 11-22 Sep. About +/-1pp (retention), +/-3pp (likes timing), +/-1 view (views).
The ratio uses counts from the same recorded observation; dates and evidence are preserved.
Views and viewers are retained as the numerator and denominator, rather than separate fitting targets.
Ratios from abbreviated or rounded counts are labeled approximate. This ratio does not measure completed full-length loops.
